subject: CommerciaTech marketplace adoption pathway and renewal coordination
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@commerciatech.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: CommerciaTech marketplace adoption pathway and renewal coordination

Hi Olivia,

Following up on our renewal calendar — I see CommerciaTech's annual contract comes up 2027-06-15. Given the size of the renewal and your interest in simplifying procurement, I wanted to propose a focused pathway to convert the renewal to Azure Marketplace billing and enable co-sell.

High-level benefits we see for your team:
- Single-pane procurement: one invoice through your Azure relationship, fewer internal PO/reapproval cycles
- Co-sell eligibility: dedicated partner engagement and account mapping for certain deal tiers
- Faster procurement turnaround: marketplace SOW + entitlements remove manual amendments

Proposed next steps (suggested mutual action plan):
1) Intro call with Ethan + our procurement lead to align timelines (this week)
2) Quick entitlement review — we send a short assessment of SKU mapping and required changes (attached)
3) Azure enrollment checklist and co-sell readiness review (we coordinate with Azure partner team)
4) Sign marketplace amendment + renew on marketplace terms before 2027-06-01 to avoid overlap

I've attached a brief assessment that maps your current invoice lines to marketplace SKUs. Can you loop in Ethan from procurement and confirm availability for a 30-minute call on Thu or Fri?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: CommerciaTech-Marketplace-Assessment.pdf
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@commerciatech.com>

Cc: Ethan Ruiz <ethan.ruiz@commerciatech.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: CommerciaTech marketplace adoption pathway and renewal coordination

Thanks Naomi — this looks very useful. I shared the assessment with Ethan. A couple of quick questions from our side:

1) What marketplace pricing delta should we expect versus our direct agreement? We need to understand the net seat/unit economics for our finance team.
2) We have some security/compliance asks (data residency + audit logs). Will converting affect any of the controls we currently have?
3) Do you support invoice-split (some seats billed through marketplace, others direct) while we transition?

Ethan and I are available Thu 4/22 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 4/23 14:00-15:00 PT. We also attached our standard PO template — hope that helps for planning.

Olivia Barnes
Director, IT Procurement | CommerciaTech
olivia.barnes@commerciatech.com | +1 212-555-0133

Attachment: PO_template.docx
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:22:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: CommerciaTech marketplace adoption pathway and renewal coordination

Forwarding Olivia's reply — they asked about pricing delta, security, and partial invoice-split.

My thoughts:
- Pricing: we can present a net-of-rebate case. For a first-year marketplace conversion we typically offer a one-time transition credit to preserve net economics; legal needs to confirm how to structure it on the amendment.
- Security/compliance: this looks like an Azure marketplace-friendly customer, but we should confirm audit-log retention and any KMS feeding. Grace, can your team check if we can surface the same audit logs when the customer is on marketplace entitlements?
- Split invoices: Product/Legal usually prefers a full migration for entitlement simplicity, but finance has supported staged cutovers. Marissa, any constraints from the revenue recognition side or preferred amendment language?

Also thinking we should loop in the Azure partner contact early to get co-sell mapping and confirm timelines. Naomi — I'll be on the Thu slot if we lock it.

— Logan
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@commerciatech.com>, Ethan Ruiz <ethan.ruiz@commerciatech.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CommerciaTech marketplace adoption pathway and renewal coordination

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies and the availability. Confirming next steps and owners so we have a clear cadence: 

- Thu 2027-04-22 10:00 PT — 30m call: Naomi, Olivia, Ethan, Logan (calendar invite sent). Objective: procurement timeline + pricing expectations.
- Action: Naomi to prepare net-of-rebate pricing scenarios and a short one-page migration playbook (by Wed EOD).
- Action: Grace to validate audit-log parity and KMS implications with infra team (status by Thu call).
- Action: Marissa to draft marketplace amendment language with a transitional credit option; share draft with legal and finance (target Fri 2027-04-30).
- Action: Naomi to introduce Azure Partner Team post-call to start co-sell mapping.

I will also attach a DocuSign link for the amendment template we typically use for marketplace transfers during the call if we confirm economics. If the customer prefers a staggered approach we can scope a 60/40 invoice-split during a 90-day transition window; finance and revenue ops have done this before and Marissa will confirm the revenue recognition notes.

Links: Enrollment checklist: https://azure.microsoft.com/partners/marketplace-enroll
Redwood onboarding for marketplace customers: https://redwood-inference.app/marketplace/onboarding/CT-1423

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Naomi Feldman
